f.title: Apply the regulatory definitions of SAE and SUSAR
f.statement: A serious adverse event is an untoward medical occurrence that, at any dose, results in death, is life-threatening, requires or prolongs hospitalisation, results in persistent or significant disability, or is a congenital anomaly or birth defect. A suspected unexpected serious adverse reaction (SUSAR) is a serious adverse reaction whose nature, severity or frequency is not identified by the reference safety information.
f.legal_basis: Pharmacy and Poisons (Conduct of Clinical Trials) Rules 2022 (LN 95/2022), r.2
f.applicability: Clinical trials approved by the Pharmacy and Poisons Board, Kenya

f.statement: The sponsor shall provide the Board with an up-to-date investigator's brochure and drug safety update report whenever available and in any case at least once a year, unless there are substantial changes to the previous version.

f.title: Establish a data and safety monitoring board for the trial
f.statement: The sponsor shall establish a data and safety monitoring board responsible for assessing trial progress, safety data and critical efficacy endpoints and recommending whether to continue, modify or stop the trial. A DSMB shall be appointed in particular where interim results might ethically require early termination, there is an a priori safety concern or prior evidence of toxicity, the population is vulnerable or at elevated risk of death or serious outcomes, or the trial runs more than three years at multiple centres.

f.legal_basis: Pharmacy and Poisons (Conduct of Clinical Trials) Rules 2022 (LN 95/2022), r.13
f.applicability: Clinical trials approved by the Pharmacy and Poisons Board, Kenya

f.title: Quality assurance ensures accurate, timely trial data and well-kept records
f.statement: The sponsor's quality assurance process shall ensure that data from the trial are recorded and reported accurately, legibly, completely and in a timely manner, that participant safety and confidentiality are not compromised, and that records, including source documents and final reports, are well kept.

f.statement: If a clinical trial is terminated voluntarily, the sponsor shall immediately inform the investigators in writing of the termination, its reasons, and advise them on the potential risks to the health of participants or other persons.

f.title: Contraventions of the Rules are offences
f.statement: Any person who contravenes the Rules commits an offence and is liable to the penalty prescribed under section 51 of the Pharmacy and Poisons Act; non-compliance found at inspection may lead to revocation or suspension of the trial authorisation.
f.legal_basis: Pharmacy and Poisons (Conduct of Clinical Trials) Rules 2022 (LN 95/2022), r.25; Pharmacy and Poisons Act s.51
